text_block_list.text:
In town, the Trainer spots an event titled 
"Satono Diamond GⅠ Victory Commemoration 
Event."

According to Satono Diamond and the others 
they bumped into, a victory celebration 
event was being held at a Satono Group 
facility.

Satono Diamond wanted to contribute in 
some way too, and went around visiting 
facilities to hand out commemorative 
gifts.

The Trainer decided to accompany the two. 
There, they learned that commemorative 
events were being held across every 
facility belonging to the Satono Group.

The Trainer truly felt just how immense a 
joy Satono Diamond's G1 victory was for 
the entire Satono family.
